properties.name: Cool Springs Park
properties.short: Rowlesburg roadside institution -- part gas station, part diner, part curiosity shop. Open daily.

properties.name: International Mother's Day Shrine
properties.short: Birthplace of Mother's Day as a national observance, in downtown Grafton. Seasonal hours, call ahead.

properties.name: Tygart Lake State Park
properties.short: Lake, dam overlook, lodge, and on-site dining a few minutes from Grafton.

properties.name: Hamilton Round Barn
properties.short: 1911 dairy barn turned museum in Mannington. Narrow visiting window, plan ahead.

properties.name: Mason-Dixon Historical Park
properties.short: Monuments, hiking, and picnicking along Dunkard Creek near Core, marking the historic Mason-Dixon Line survey.

properties.name: Rosemary's Thyme
properties.short: Family-owned authentic Mexican in Kingwood with Cheat River and golf-course views - right by the Preston County Inn.

properties.name: RG's Almost Heaven Harley-Davidson
properties.short: Family-run Harley-Davidson dealer near Bridgeport - sales, service, parts, and gear, in business since 1977.

properties.name: Almost Heaven Swing - Valley Falls State Park
properties.short: Overlooks the cascades of Valley Falls, a stop on the WV Waterfall Trail; cross the bridge and follow the paved path.

properties.name: Barrackville Covered Bridge
properties.short: Built 1853 by Lemuel Chenoweth, a 146-ft Burr-arch span and one of the oldest covered bridges in West Virginia.

properties.name: Fish Creek Covered Bridge
properties.short: ca. 1881 King-post covered bridge over Fish Creek at Hundred.

properties.name: Triple S Harley-Davidson
properties.short: Full Harley-Davidson dealer in Morgantown, right off I-79 Exit 155 - bikes, parts, service, and gear.

properties.name: Preston County Inn
properties.short: Historic 1857 inn on Kingwood's Main Street, with its own restaurant and bar - a characterful Preston County overnight.
